heading: موارد وجوب خمس
topic: The seven things liable to khums
states: Business and work income, mixed lawful/unlawful wealth, mines, treasure, gems from diving, spoils of war, land a dhimmi buys from a Muslim.

heading: درآمد کسب و کار
states: Income from trade, industry, farming, salaries and wages, renting property and similar: at the khums year end, khums on what exceeds the expenses of oneself and dependants.

heading: درآمد کسب و کار
states: Spending beyond the customary and need, not counting as mu'nah, does not escape khums.
issues: Excess beyond status is the person's own determination.

heading: درآمد کسب و کار
topic: Income temporarily out of reach (e.g. lent)
states: Khums becomes due at year end but payment may be delayed until it is received.

heading: درآمد کسب و کار
states: Valued at the khums year end.
issues: Needs year-end value input.

heading: درآمد کسب و کار
states: Costs of earning plus all lawful spending within custom and one's status.

heading: سرمایه
topic: Working capital (stock, cash in trade, products)
states: Bought from income: khums at that day's value at the first year end after purchase; afterwards, growth over last year, after deducting inflation, is liable if sellable.
issues: Needs year-end value and an inflation figure (user input); valuation capability missing.

heading: سرمایه
topic: Fixed capital (premises, farm land, tools, transport vehicles)
states: Bought from income: khums at that day's value at the first year end after purchase; then not liable until sold; on sale the rise after deducting inflation is income of the year of sale. If years passed unpaid, khums is paid together with inflation.
issues: Needs value at the first year end and an inflation adjustment (user figures).

heading: سرمایه در گردش
states: Stock bought from earnings is liable.

heading: سرمایه در گردش
states: The price at which it can be sold all at once at the khums year end.
issues: The person enters that value.

heading: سرمایه در گردش
states: With taxed initial capital: from the first year, growth that counts as profit and has value is liable after deducting inflation, each year; on sale, the proceeds minus taxed capital and its inflation (and previously taxed growth with its inflation) are profit; unpaid growth is paid at once with the currency's loss considered.
issues: Agricultural valuation is outside the inputs.

heading: محلّ کسب
topic: Shop bought years ago without a khums year
states: Pay khums on its value at the first khums year end after purchase, together with inflation.
issues: Needs value at the first year end and the inflation adjustment (user figures).

heading: محلّ کسب
topic: Farm land bought decades ago, unpaid
states: If bought from earnings or salary: khums on its value at the first khums year end after purchase, paid together with inflation.

heading: محلّ کسب
states: Khums on business premises is due, unless after paying it the rest cannot cover living costs within one's status.
issues: Hardship is the person's own answer.

heading: ابزار کسب
states: Capital: if bought from income, khums on its value at the first year end after purchase, then not liable until sold; on sale the added value after inflation is income of that year.

heading: ابزار کسب
topic: Furniture and equipment at the workplace
states: Liable if bought from income.

heading: ابزار کسب
states: Valued at its sellable value at the first year end.

heading: تهیّه اقساطی ابزار کسب و سرمایه
states: At each year end, khums on the share whose instalments were paid, at that day's value (e.g. a quarter paid → a fifth of a quarter of the value).
issues: Needs the paid proportion and current value.

heading: تهیّه اقساطی ابزار کسب و سرمایه
states: Khums on half the taxi's value at the year end.

heading: تهیّه اقساطی ابزار کسب و سرمایه
topic: Flat bought with a loan for children
states: If given to the children or it is one's mu'nah, loan instalments owe nothing; otherwise khums each year on the share paid.

heading: تهیّه اقساطی ابزار کسب و سرمایه
topic: Livestock bought with a loan for trade
states: Khums on its value in proportion to paid instalments.

heading: سرمایه ای که خمس ندارد
states: If paying khums on capital would leave too little for living costs, or this is doubtful, it is not due, even if it could be paid in instalments.
issues: Already encoded in the 0.10.0 packs (kha-ftk-hardship); hardship is the person's answer.

heading: سرمایه ای که خمس ندارد
topic: Work vehicle that must be replaced
states: Not due if, after paying it, one could not buy another vehicle whose income covers living costs.

heading: سرمایه ای که خمس ندارد
topic: Home lived in vs business premises
states: The home lived in owes nothing; the business premises owe khums unless the hardship exception applies.

heading: ترقّی قیمت کالا
states: A rise caused by inflation (the money's loss of value) is not a price rise; khums rules on rises do not apply to it.
issues: Needs an inflation figure (user input); the calculator never fetches one.

heading: کسر تورّم
states: On repayment a creditor may claim the money's loss of value, except cases like a rent deposit where non-compensation is implicitly agreed.

heading: کسر تورّم
states: Deduct the taxed building cost with its inflation from the sale price; the rest is profit.

heading: سود بانکها با توجّه به تورّم
states: Profit on a taxed deposit that does not exceed inflation owes nothing.
issues: Needs the inflation figure.

heading: سود و ارزش افزوده مال مخمّس
topic: Added value of taxed or untaxable property
states: (a) mu'nah: none; (b) bought to keep money's value: none before sale, after sale the part above inflation is income; (c) fixed capital: as (b); (d) working capital: added value at each year end at sellable price after inflation is liable.

heading: سود و ارزش افزوده مال مخمّس
states: After taxing it in the first year, no recalculation until sold; on sale, profit after inflation is income of that year.

heading: سود و ارزش افزوده مال مخمّس
topic: Work machine bought with untaxable money
states: Not liable until sold; on sale, added value after inflation is income.

heading: سود و ارزش افزوده مال مخمّس
topic: Taxed carpet sold at a profit
states: The growth after inflation is income of the year of sale, liable if unspent.

heading: سود و ارزش افزوده مال مخمّس
states: Bought from income: khums on its value at the first year end after purchase; then not until sold; on sale, added value after inflation is income of that year.

heading: سهام و اوراق بهادار
topic: Shares bought to keep value or for dividends
states: Bought from income: khums at that day's price at the first year end; then not until sold; on sale, the rise after inflation is income of the year of sale.
issues: Needs value at first year end, sale price and inflation (user figures).

heading: سهام و اوراق بهادار
states: Khums at that day's price at the first year end, then each year end on the rise after inflation.

heading: سهام و اوراق بهادار
states: Liable; khums is computed at year end once the price is determined.

heading: سهام عدالت
states: Once released, the sellable part is liable at the first year end at its market price; for low-income groups whose shares were discounted, half is liable and half is a gift; those who need the shares and their dividends to live within status owe nothing; dividends are income of the year they became collectable.
issues: Iran-specific instrument: stop for review.

heading: سهام سقوط کرده در بورس
topic: Shares bought with a loan that fell in value
states: Khums on the shares' value at the year end.

heading: مطالبات فروش قسطی
topic: Sales on credit collected after the year
states: The cash price at the time of sale is income of the year of sale; the credit mark-up is income of the year received.
issues: Needs the cash price and the mark-up separately.

heading: مطالبات فروش قسطی
states: If capital did not grow, nothing is due; if it grew, collectable credit-sale profits are liable after deducting capital and its inflation; uncollectable ones belong to the year collected; profit already converted to goods and sold on credit is paid at once when received.

heading: مطالبات بابت اجرت کار
states: Not collectable at year end: income of the year received (exempt if spent on needs that year); collectable at year end: liable even if not yet received.
issues: Whether collectable at year end is the person's answer.

heading: قرض دادن
states: Lending income to people or a bank does not remove khums; when repaid after the year, pay khums at once (also if repaid in kind).

heading: قرض گرفتن
topic: Borrowed money still held at year end
states: Not liable, except the part of the loan still held (unspent on needs or turned into capital) exceeding the remaining instalments paid from the year's income (example: 50 of 100 held, 40 outstanding → khums on 10).
issues: Needs loan held and outstanding balance.

heading: سرمایه صندوق قرض الحسنه خانگی یا مجموعه خاص
states: Each member's contributions from income are liable at their year end if collectable, otherwise when collectable; a received loan splits into last year's contributions (liable at once), this year's (liable if unspent), and a loan.

heading: سپرده گذاری بلندمدّت
states: Treated as capital: liable, paid together with inflation (current value).

heading: پیش دریافتِ اجرت
states: Liable only for the part matching work already done.

heading: پیش پرداخت هایی که هنوز مئونه نشده
topic: Travel booked and paid before the year end
states: Mu'nah of the year of payment if booking at that time was customarily necessary.
issues: 'Customarily necessary' is the person's answer.

heading: پیش پرداخت خرید خودرو
states: If an investment (profit added): principal and collectable profit liable; if a purchase of a needed personal car within status: exempt; a refunded pre-payment whose year passed is liable.

heading: پول حج
states: Principal from untaxed income is liable; profit liable if collectable; money set aside for hajj or umrah is liable.

heading: حقوق بازنشستگی
states: A retiree's pension is liable like salary.
issues: Already encoded in the 0.10.0 packs (kha-pension).

heading: اضافه بر مئونه
states: Items needed before the year end that must be in the home owe nothing even if unused; not needed: liable at year-end value.

heading: اضافه بر مئونه
states: Valuable left-overs at year end are liable at year-end value; worthless remains (opened jars) are not.

heading: سکّه طلا
states: Bought from income: liable at its value at the first year end (year-end price).

heading: سکّه طلا
topic: Gold coins held as trading capital
states: Paying khums from the coins themselves does not stop yearly rises (after inflation) being liable.

heading: نگهداری یا سپرده گذاری طلا
topic: Gold kept as savings or in a bank
states: Liable if bought from salary or income.

heading: سرقفلی
states: Capital: liable at its value at the first year end, paid with inflation if unpaid; on sale, the amount above taxed value and inflation is income of the year received.

heading: محصولات کشاورزی
states: Harvestable produce at year end is liable even if not harvested or sold; unripe produce if it counts as profit and has value; if unsellable at year end, obligatory precaution to pay from other property if possible.
issues: Agricultural valuation is outside the inputs.

heading: محصولات کشاورزی
states: Treated as capital and liable, unless paying it would leave too little for living costs.

heading: بذر و کود مصرفی
topic: Seed whose khums was not paid
states: Pay khums on the seed and its inflation as well as the crop.

heading: بذر و کود مصرفی
states: Liable if bought from the year's income and not customarily considered consumed.

heading: درآمد از غیر مسلمانان
states: Liable if unspent at year end.

heading: درآمد کارهای عبادی
states: Income from eulogy recitation, hired prayers or Qur'an reading is liable if unspent.

heading: برگشت مبلغ کسر شده بابت ضمانت دیگران
states: Amounts deducted from salary for a guaranteed loan and repaid after the year: khums at the time received.

heading: تبدیل درآمد به سکّه یا کالا قبل از سال خمسی
topic: Converting income to coins or goods for future needs
states: Does not remove khums.

heading: پول پس اندازشده برای مئونه آینده
states: Contributions from the year's income still owned at the year end are liable.

heading: مبلغ مسدود شده در بانک
topic: Loan amount blocked by the bank
states: If instalments were paid from income, liable; the part whose year passed is paid when released.

heading: خانه اجاره داده شده
topic: Floors of a home rented out
states: Bought to live in and rented by necessity: not liable; bought to rent out: liable at its value at the first year end after purchase.

heading: صندوق پس انداز، قانون تسرّی، صندوق تأمین آتیه
topic: Compulsory and voluntary savings or pension funds
states: Deducted without choice: income of the year received. Deducted by agreement and collectable: liable each year end. Not collectable: when received, pay at once on the part whose year passed; the latest year's part is income of the year received.
issues: Whether deductions are compulsory and collectable is the person's answer.

heading: ردّ مظالمِ کنارگذاشته شده
topic: Money set aside for radd al-mazalim
states: Liable while still owned, with its profits.

heading: مشارکت گروهی در سرمایه و حکم خمس آن
states: Khums is only on natural persons; legal persons without real owners owe none; owners pay pro rata.

heading: مشارکت گروهی در سرمایه و حکم خمس آن
topic: Partners in a venture with a loan
states: Each pays khums on his share of initial capital, loan instalments and profit.

heading: پول مضاربه ی باقیمانده یا تبدیل شده به کالا
topic: Money in mudaraba at year end
states: No need to cancel the contract, but khums is due at the year end (even from other funds), including when turned into goods.

heading: کسر بدهی از موجودی پایان سال
states: Any debt relating to income existing at year end is deducted from it (worked murabaha example).
issues: Already encoded in the 0.10.0 packs (kha-debts).

heading: مال مخلوط با حرام
topic: Mixed wealth: unknown amount and owner
states: Paying khums on the whole makes it lawful; mere doubt of mixing creates no duty.

heading: مال مخلوط با حرام
topic: Unlawful part known to exceed a fifth
states: By precaution, pay khums plus the amount certainly beyond it to a jurist to use as both khums and charity.

heading: مال مخلوط با حرام
states: First pay a fifth of the whole to make it lawful; then for the income khums either pay a fifth of the certain lawful amount (if less than a fifth of the rest) or a fifth of the rest (worked example).
issues: Not encoded in the calculator.

heading: راه حلال شدنِ مال به دست آمده از سرمایه حرام
states: Known owners: gain their consent; unknown owners, known amount: give as charity for them; unknown amount and owners: khums on the capital and its profit.

heading: معدن
states: Extracted value after extraction and refining costs equal to 15 mithqal of gold: khums is due; below that, none. Above or below ground, own or ownerless land. Each partner's share must reach the nisab. Payment is immediate, not tied to the khums year.
issues: Needs the value of 15 mithqal of gold on the date (user input); the gram weight is not stated in this source.

heading: معدن
states: Not established that they count as mines: no mine khums on them.

heading: گنج
states: Worth 20 gold dinars or 200 silver dirhams: khums at once, regardless of the khums year; legal regulations on finds are followed; found on acquired land, offer it to previous owners first.
issues: Needs dinar/dirham values (user input).

heading: جواهری که با غوّاصی به دست آید
states: After extraction costs, worth 18 nukhud of gold or more: liable; dives close together combined; big rivers (Nile, Euphrates, Karun) as the sea by obligatory precaution; with a device without diving: obligatory precaution; found on the surface or shore: none unless it is one's work (then business income).
issues: Needs threshold capability.

heading: دستۀ اول
states: For non-consumables the test is availability when needed: if needed at purchase in that sense, not liable even if unused.

heading: دستۀ اول
states: Not liable if needed and within status.

heading: دستۀ اول
topic: Purchase of needed items delayed past the year end
states: If needed and purchase was attempted but delayed involuntarily, no khums if bought without delay.

heading: دستۀ اول
topic: Home purchase cancelled by the seller before the year end
states: No khums if another home is bought without delay.

heading: زمین یا باغ تفریحی
topic: Leisure garden or land for one
states: Not liable if within status and for personal need.

heading: زینت آلات
states: Bought monthly from income for customary adornment within status: not liable.

heading: حیوانات
states: Not liable if within status.

heading: حیوانات
states: Not liable if not beyond need; their products unconsumed at year end are.

heading: کلکسیون
states: Not liable if within status and not bought or kept for trade.

heading: دستۀ دوم
states: Not liable; the test is customary consumption.

heading: باقیمانده موادّ مصرفی
states: Bulk-available items (pulses, meat): khums on the remainder; packaged items bought as needed: an opened package owes nothing.

heading: لوازم التّحریر
states: Needed and within status: none, except consumable stationery left over and sellable.

heading: داروی اضافی
states: None if it must be at hand or smaller quantities are not available.

heading: شارژ سیم کارت و اینترنت
states: None if bought in customary amounts and unsellable.

heading: شأن در هدیه
states: Mu'nah within the giver's status; the giver pays khums on the excess.

heading: قبض و تحویل هدیه و سوغات
topic: Gifts or souvenirs not delivered by year end
states: Not mu'nah: liable, including souvenirs kept for later.

heading: پس گرفتن هدیه
topic: Gift taken back after the year
states: Liable as soon as received back.

heading: هدیه مالی که خمسش داده نشده است
topic: Giving property whose khums is unpaid
states: Allowed; the giver remains liable (also to a mosque).

heading: هدیه به همسر و فرزند
states: Gold for a wife within custom and status is mu'nah; real (not sham) gifts within status are exempt; sham gifts between spouses to avoid khums do not remove it; real gifts of savings to a child are exempt; a property gifted to a child or a flat as a wedding gift is exempt if within status and before the year passes.
issues: Whether a gift is real and within status is the person's answer.

heading: صدقات و حقوق شرعیّه
states: Mu'nah: no khums.

heading: اسراف و مئونه حرام
states: Not mu'nah: liable (e.g. men's gold ring, gambling tools); a man's gold necklace bought from income: khums on its value at the first year end adjusted for the currency's loss; extravagant wedding costs beyond status are liable.
issues: Extravagance is the person's own determination.

heading: صرفه جویی بیش از متعارف در مئونه
topic: Saving by living below one's status
states: Amounts saved cannot be counted as mu'nah.

heading: صرف درآمد برای فرار از خمس
states: No khums if the spending is customary and not extravagant.

heading: عدم استفاده وسایل چندتکّه ای
states: The test is need within status, not use; a full set is exempt if buying it whole is customary or needed; otherwise unneeded volumes are liable; reading one page of each does not help.

heading: تهیّه مئونه مورد نیاز آینده به صورت تدریجی
states: Customary advance acquisition within status counts as mu'nah (trousseau, groom's items); items bought cheap for use after a future marriage are liable unless advance acquisition is customary and within status; land and an unfinished home for one's needed housing are exempt; a land allocation right bought (partly on loan) for needed housing is exempt.
issues: Custom and status are the person's answers.

heading: خانه برای آینده فرزندان
topic: A home for one's children's future
states: Exempt if providing housing is customarily the father's duty and he could not do it when needed.

heading: پس انداز درآمد برای جهیزیّه
states: Savings are liable; but a sum kept for emergencies is exempt if, after paying khums, the remainder would not suffice to relieve the concern. Money deposited for a daughter is exempt if gifted to her, liable if only in her name.
exceptions: Emergency savings that would not suffice after khums
issues: Sufficiency and concern are the person's answers.

heading: پول پیش پرداخت برای خرید مئونه
states: Exempt if acquiring the land requires the pre-payment.

heading: تهیّه اقساطی مئونه
states: Instalments paid from the year's income are exempt.

heading: مایحتاج خریداری شده برای یک سال
topic: Supplies bought for the coming year
states: Items needed before the year end: none; items for after the year end: liable.

heading: خرید مایحتاج با پول مخمّس
states: No khums.

heading: خرید مئونه با پول متعلَّق خمس
topic: Needs bought with income whose khums was due
states: Mu'nah status does not waive it: pay khums on the purchase price together with its inflation; a home built from income whose year passed: khums on that money at the first year end, with inflation.
issues: Already encoded in the 0.10.0 packs (kha-ftk-*); needs purchase price and inflation (user figures).

heading: خروج از مئونه
states: After its first year: no khums; before its first year end: khums at that day's value; replacing a carpet after years: neither owes.

heading: خانه مئونه اجاره داده شده
states: Residence is not a condition: if needed and within status it is mu'nah; sold after the year its price owes nothing; rent is income.

heading: تبدیل مئونه به مئونه دیگر
states: No khums.

heading: تبدیل خانه کلنگی به واحدهای آپارتمانی
topic: Old home exchanged for several flats
states: Needed flats: none; extra flat for rent: none until sold, then the rise after principal and inflation is income; extra flat to sell: yearly rise after inflation is liable.

heading: تبدیل مئونه به سرمایه
topic: Sale of old mu'nah put into business capital
states: The sale money owes nothing, even as capital; its yearly rise after inflation is liable; changing use of a parking or home after the year owes nothing (recommended precaution on the rise if sold).

heading: مغازه یا انبار تجاری ملحق به منزل
topic: Shop attached to a home bought
states: Bought for residential use: none; usable only commercially: beyond mu'nah and liable.

heading: فروش مئونه
states: Sold after the year: no khums on the price; a work vehicle taxed at its initial price: rise after initial price and inflation is income; home sold and money banked or saved for a home: none; needed items sold to buy better before the year or after: none.

heading: زمین و خانه فروخته شده
topic: Taxed land sold to buy a home the same year
states: No khums.

heading: پس انداز برای آینده نزدیک
states: Savings are liable unless spent on needs within five days after the year end; emergency savings that would not suffice after khums are exempt.
issues: Five-day window needs dates; the calculator can ask.

heading: آخرین حقوق سال
topic: Last salary before the year end
states: Exempt if spent within five days after the year end, or if after khums the rest would not cover next month's expenses.

heading: پس انداز برای تهیّه ضروریّات زندگی
topic: Savings for necessary housing or essentials
states: Savings for future living costs are liable; savings for essential items or necessary costs spent in the near future after the year end are exempt.
issues: 'Near future' is not quantified: asked or stopped.

heading: پس انداز حقوق برای هزینه های ازدواج
states: If steps towards marriage have begun (even proposing), khums on those savings need not be paid and they may be used for the marriage. Seminary stipends are not liable; preaching or work income is.
issues: Whether steps have begun is the person's answer.

heading: پس انداز برای ساخت خانه
topic: Savings to build a home on owned land
states: If needed building materials are bought before the year end, no khums.

heading: مؤونه کسب درآمد
states: Spending that earns profit with nothing replacing it (transport, staff wages, shop rent, utilities, tax) counts as lost and is not liable; if paid from non-income money it is deducted from that year's profit.
issues: Already encoded in the 0.10.0 packs (kha-business-cost).

heading: مؤونه کسب درآمد
states: Liable if it raises the premises' value or is movable and sellable; otherwise treated as lost; for taxed premises, only the rise caused by spending income on it is liable.

heading: مؤونه کسب درآمد
topic: Rental home built partly from the year's income
states: Khums on the home's value at the first year end after deducting land, materials (taxed) and their inflation.

heading: مالیات
states: Tax is mu'nah and unrelated to khums; unpaid tax for this year's earnings is deducted from that income; past years' tax can be paid from this year's income before the year end but deducted only if it relates to this year.

heading: بدهی و مال قرضی
states: Needs debts and non-replaced business costs of this and past years may be paid from this year's income up to five days after the year end. Needs debts of this year arising after the year's first income may be deducted without paying them; needs debts arising before the year's first income are not deductible (obligatory precaution). Untaxable money (gifts, inheritance, taxed money) spent on these after the first income is deducted. An unpaid business debt is deducted only from the income it produced (not e.g. from salary).
conditions: Within five days after the year end (payment)
issues: Already partly encoded in the 0.10.0 packs (kha-debts, kha-old-debts); needs the date of the first income and of each debt.

heading: بدهی و مال قرضی
topic: Repaying debt shortly after the year end
states: Paying soon after the year end from that year's income, to the extent customarily counted as that year's spending, is deducted; otherwise all unspent income is liable.
issues: 'Shortly' is not quantified beyond the five-day rule.

heading: بدهی بابت مئونه زندگی
topic: Needs debt not demanded at year end
states: Deducted from new income if the spending came after the year's first income; past years' needs debts: no khums only if paid within five days after the year end.

heading: بدهی بابت مئونه زندگی
topic: Cheque for living costs cashed on the year end
states: No khums.

heading: بدهی بابت مئونه زندگی
states: Bought this year after the first income: the debt is deducted; bought before this year: only if paid within five days after the year end.

heading: بدهی بابت مئونه زندگی
states: Deducted to the extent of education provided after the year's first income; the rest only if paid within five days after the year end.

heading: کارمندان دارای بدهی نقدی و قسطی
topic: Employees with cash and instalment debts
states: Debts for that year's expenses or credit purchases made after the year's first income are deducted.

heading: بدهی بابت مئونه کسب و کار
states: Deductible, even if not yet due.

heading: بدهی بابت مئونه کسب و کار
states: An unpaid wage receivable owes nothing; a lent-income receivable: if owing an equal debt for this year's business or post-first-income needs, deduct; if the debt is from past years, deduct only if the receivable is collected before the year end.

heading: وام و قرض دریافتی موجود
topic: Unspent borrowed money at year end
states: Not liable; if a loan is held while instalments are being paid, the part held above the remaining instalments is liable.

heading: اقساط وام طولانی مدّت
topic: Instalments of a loan spent on needs
states: Not liable, in any year; but deduction (without paying) is only from the income of the year of spending, after its first income. Merely being in debt does not prevent khums; paying future instalments early is allowed, but an unspent or capitalised loan is liable.

heading: خمس پول امانتی
topic: Money held in trust for another
states: Not the holder's khums.

heading: قرض در ازای اجاره
states: A landlord's loan from a tenant owes no khums.

heading: قرض در ازای اجاره
states: No khums if the tenant cannot pay full rent or the landlord refuses: treated as mu'nah.

heading: اموال مخمّس
topic: Taxed income is not taxed again
states: Income once taxed owes no further khums.

heading: کسر مقدار مخمّس از موجودی سال
topic: Taxed balance carried into the next year
states: If last year's taxed balance was unspent, or spent on needs after the new year's first income, only the new addition is liable; comparing balances is wrong (obligatory precaution) when old taxed money was spent before the new year's first income.
issues: Needs the taxed balance and the date of the year's first income (carry-over).

heading: کسر مال غیر متعلَّق خمس از محاسبه خمس سرمایه
states: Deducted at year end together with its inflation.

heading: ابزار کسب مخمّس
states: Not liable until sold; on sale, price minus taxed value and its inflation is income of the year of sale.

heading: سرمایه در گردش مخمّس
states: At each year end, value it (estimated if hard) and pay khums on the excess over last year's value plus inflation, if sellable; sale or not makes no difference; stale stock, goods bought on credit (their rise only) and capital from gifts follow the same test.
issues: Needs last year's taxed value, this year's value and inflation.

heading: اختلاط درآمد متعلّق خمس و مال غیر متعلّق خمس
topic: Income and untaxable money in one account
states: While liable income remains, withdrawals for needs come from the liable income (no intention needed); the untaxable money stays protected.

heading: اختلاط درآمد متعلّق خمس و مال غیر متعلّق خمس
topic: Account with taxed and new money
states: Deduct the balance present when the year's first salary arrived from the year-end balance and pay khums on the rest; wedding gift and marriage loan spent normally, instalments not paid from income: none.
issues: Needs the balance on the date of the first income.

heading: جبران خسارات سرمایه
states: Wear, fall in value of tools and accidental losses to capital are deducted at year end, whether before or after the year's first income (unlike mu'nah); theft or fire of capital too.
issues: Already encoded in the 0.10.0 packs (kha-capital-loss).

heading: جبران خسارات سرمایه
states: Liable only on the excess of current herd and cash over last year's herd and cash plus inflation.

heading: هدیه (هبه)
states: Property or money one had no right to claim (gifts, veterans' foundation payments, subsidies, bank prizes, allowances) is not liable; recommended precaution to pay if left over.
issues: Already encoded in the 0.10.0 packs (kha-gift); recommended precaution is not applied.

heading: افزایش قیمت اموال موهوب
topic: Rise in value of gifted property
states: Not held for trade: none on sale. Put up for sale as capital: the sale price minus initial value and inflation is income of the year of sale (obligatory precaution).

heading: حقّ همسر از حقوق کارمندی و پرداخت آن به وی
topic: Spouse allowance passed to the wife
states: No khums.

heading: شیربها
states: No khums.

heading: عیدی و پاداش
states: Not liable (including end-of-service reward).
issues: Already encoded in the 0.10.0 packs (kha-bonus).

heading: سنوات
topic: Severance (sanavat) under contract or labour law
states: Income: liable if unspent at year end.

heading: کمک معیشت
states: Free goods: never liable; half-price goods: what remains above half at year end is liable.

heading: حقوق جانبازان، آزادگان و خانواده ی شهدا
topic: Payments to veterans, former captives and martyrs' families
states: Not liable; a spouse's carer pay given for caring work is liable if left over.
issues: Iran-specific categories: asked as a confirmation.

heading: خمس سرمایه فرزندان شاهد
states: Stipend not liable; profit on its savings is liable if above the inflation of the principal; profit from inherited property is income.

heading: کارانه
states: Payments one is entitled to by contract (claimable if withheld) are income; payments given without entitlement are not liable.
issues: Entitlement is the person's answer.

heading: جایزه ی بانکی
states: Not liable.

heading: هبه پول برای خرجی خانه
topic: Housekeeping money given to a wife
states: Spent on household needs: never liable, gifted or not.

heading: کمک هزینه تحصیلی
states: Not liable, including savings from them; a sponsored student's salary is liable.

heading: نفقه
states: Maintenance from husband, father or children is never liable; money a wife takes for herself as permitted is not liable.

heading: ارث
states: Inheritance and its sale price are not liable even if the value rose, unless held as capital for sale: then the added value after sale and inflation is income (obligatory precaution); profit on a child's inheritance is liable (guardian, or the child after maturity).
issues: Already encoded in the 0.10.0 packs (kha-inheritance).

heading: مهریه
states: Not liable; mahr coins held for profit: rise after sale and inflation by precaution; profit on invested mahr above its inflation is liable.

heading: وقف
states: Endowed property and its yield are not liable for beneficiaries, even private endowment, except where it is acquired by work; precaution is better.
issues: Differs from Sistani (Tawdih 1775).

heading: دیه
states: Not liable; bank profit on it above its inflation is liable.

heading: مبالغ پرداخت شده به بیمه
states: Premiums from the year's income (life, retirement, accident, fire, vehicle) are mu'nah; investment-type payments from income are liable each year end.

heading: پول دریافتی از بیمه
states: Compensation paid to the insured (vehicle, fire, crops) is earned income; paid to a non-party it is not liable; life-insurance payouts to spouse and children are not liable, to oneself income of the year received.

heading: پول بیمه تکمیلی
states: If treatment was paid from the year's income, the refund reduces the cost: liable if unspent at year end; received after the year end: pay at once.

heading: بیمه بیکاری
states: Under an employer–insurer contract: not liable; under a worker–insurer contract or a condition the worker set: income.
issues: Which contract applies is the person's answer.

heading: بیمه بیکاری
states: Monthly pension paid to survivors after the insured's death is not liable.

heading: سال خمسی
states: Anyone with any income must have a khums year and assess the year's income (Q224: unmarried youths with income too).

heading: سال خمسی
states: Her khums year starts at her first income; pay on what was not spent on needs (pilgrimage, gifts…).

heading: سال خمسی
states: Keeping a khums year is a means, not a duty in itself: if all income is spent on needs, nothing is due.

heading: سال خمسی
states: Not obligatory before the year end even if income will remain unspent.
issues: Differs from Sistani 1783 (obligatory precaution).

heading: نحوه تعیین سال خمسی
topic: How the khums year is set
states: Not chosen: daily earners (shopkeepers, taxi drivers) from starting work; periodic earners (monthly) from the first income; farmers from when produce counts as profit with value.
issues: Already encoded in the 0.10.0 packs (kha-ftk-year).

heading: نحوه تعیین سال خمسی
states: If paid as wages, the year starts with it; if as aid or gift, it is not liable and the year starts with the first official salary.

heading: نحوه تعیین سال خمسی
states: The date the cheque is cashed counts.

heading: نحوه تعیین سال خمسی
states: At the first opportunity assess with the Marja's agent on the real year if known; if unknown, by settlement with the agent the assessment date becomes the year point.
issues: Settlement is with an agent: recorded, not computed.

heading: نحوه تعیین سال خمسی
states: Either; the person chooses.

heading: نحوه تعیین سال خمسی
states: Same length: use the equivalent solar date.

heading: تقدیم و تأخیر سال خمسی
states: Allowed: assess early and make that the new date.

heading: تقدیم و تأخیر سال خمسی
states: Not allowed; to move it later, assess at the current date, then again at the new date.

heading: مبدأ سال خمسی جدید
topic: Gap before the new year's first income
states: If there is a gap after the year end before the new first income, the new year may start at that first income.

heading: کسی که سال خمسی نداشته است
topic: First assessment: items of unknown source
states: If known to be bought with saved income whose year passed: khums on the purchase price with inflation; if unknown (no yearly assessments, possible year passage): settlement.
issues: Already encoded in the 0.10.0 packs; settlement stops.

heading: تعیین سال مالی مشترک زن و شوهر
states: Allowed if both dates coincide or one brings the year forward.

heading: محاسبه خمس اموال میّت
states: Assess to the date of death and pay on the surplus; minor heirs do not prevent it; funeral costs from the estate owe nothing (Q239).
issues: The calculator assesses living persons.

heading: خمس افراد نابالغ
states: Liable if unspent; guardian pays or the child after maturity; gifts to a child are not liable but their profit above inflation is (Q241).

heading: خمس مجنون
states: Liable; guardian pays, otherwise on recovery or from the estate.

heading: محاسبه خمس چند شغل
states: Separate capital and accounts: each line assessed alone, losses not offset; shared accounts: assessed together.
issues: Already encoded in the 0.10.0 packs (kha-business-lines).

heading: محاسبه خمس چند شغل
states: With separate accounts each job has its own year; no offsetting; khums of one job paid from another job's untaxed income is insufficient unless a quarter is paid.
issues: Separate cycles need date capability.

heading: پرداخت خمس از درآمد سال بعد
topic: Paying a property's khums from next year's income
states: Then khums is also due on the amount paid as khums.
issues: Needs carry-over of khums paid from untaxed income.

heading: پرداخت خمس از درآمد سال بعد
topic: Paying last year's khums from this year's income
states: At year end also pay khums on what was paid for last year, or first tax the new income and pay from it.

heading: عوض کردن مال مخمّس با غیر مخمّس
topic: Swapping taxed and untaxed money by intention
states: Not needed: at year end, if the balance does not exceed the taxed amount, nothing is due.

heading: اقسام شک
states: Doubt about a past calculation's correctness: valid. Doubt whether liable property was paid: pay. Doubt between liable income and a gift: not due. Doubt whether income is this year's or last year's: at the year end, settle with a jurist by precaution; before the year end, count it as this year's.
issues: Settlement stops.

heading: شک در پرداخت خمس
states: Must pay.

heading: شک در تعلّق خمس
states: If unsure whether it is a gift or income: not due; if from not calculating, investigate and calculate.

heading: شک در تعلّق خمس
states: Counts as the new year's income.

heading: شک در زمان خرید مئونه
topic: Unsure whether mu'nah was bought before or after the year end
states: With a khums year: no duty.

heading: شک در زمان خرید مئونه
topic: Years without assessment: unknown source of household items
states: Without a khums year and unsure whether the year had passed on the money: settle with a representative by obligatory precaution.

heading: عدم توانایی پرداخت خمس
states: Does not cancel the duty: pay gradually as able at the first opportunity (Q253); abroad, calculate and arrange gradual payment with an agent (Q254); unknown amount after years: calculate and settle with the office or agent (Q255).
issues: Settlement and gradual payment are with an agent.

heading: تأخیر در پرداخت خمس و پرداخت قسطی
states: Payment should not be delayed beyond a few days after the year end; if unable, pay whenever and however much is possible (Q257–258); salary may not be banked to pay later (Q259).

heading: تأخیر در پرداخت خمس و پرداخت قسطی
states: No penalty, but the person is liable for inflation (the money's loss of value).
issues: Already encoded in the 0.10.0 packs as a review (consult-missed-inflation); needs an inflation figure as user input.

heading: تأخیر در پرداخت خمس و پرداخت قسطی
states: Not allowed; if delayed, the loss of value (inflation) must be made up.

heading: تأخیر در پرداخت خمس و پرداخت قسطی
states: Khums on all of it, not only what is taken out.

heading: تأخیر در پرداخت خمس و پرداخت قسطی
states: Each person takes permissions on their khums from their own Marja's office or representative.

heading: تأخیر در پرداخت خمس و پرداخت قسطی
topic: Part of old khums unpaid for years
states: If truly unable, pay as able; if able but did not pay, also pay the loss of value.
issues: Ability is the person's answer.

heading: تأخیر در پرداخت خمس و پرداخت قسطی
states: Pay at today's value.

heading: تأخیر در پرداخت خمس و پرداخت قسطی
topic: Spending just after the year end
states: Delay customarily counted as spending on needs or repaying debts is allowed (buy a needed item or repay a debt before paying khums).

heading: کنار گذاشتن خمس
states: Setting it aside does not permit delay or discharge the duty (Q268); money set aside and used in a deal must be paid with its loss of value (Q269).

heading: پرداخت جداگانه خمس هر درآمد
topic: Paying khums on each income as received
states: Allowed instead of keeping a year.

heading: پرداخت جداگانه خمس هر درآمد
topic: Large income near the year end
states: No separate year: pay at the year end unless spent on needs within five days after it; emergency savings exception applies.

heading: مصارف خمس و مستحقین آن
states: Khums consists of two equal parts, the Imam's share and the sayyids' share; it is to be given to the Marja's office or agent.
issues: Already encoded in the 0.10.0 packs (kha-distribution).

heading: ولی امر خمس
states: Khums must reach the authority (directly or through intermediaries) with a sealed receipt; all spending of both shares needs his permission; paying directly to the poor needs permission; zakat may be given directly.

heading: پرداخت وجوهات به غیر ولی امر خمس
states: Followers of any Marja who pay according to their own Marja's fatwa have discharged the duty.

heading: تجدید اجازه از مرجع زنده
states: An agent of a previous Marja needs fresh permission.
issues: Relevant to the continued-taqlid questions after his death; scholar to review.

heading: سهم سادات
states: Recipient not one's dependant, legally poor (yearly income does not cover expenses), paid in cash (not goods without consent), Twelver Shia; working sayyids qualify if still poor.

heading: پرداخت خمس به پدر و مادر یا فرزند فقیر
states: Not allowed to parents, grandparents, children or grandchildren who are one's dependants, even for non-obligatory needs.

heading: تصرف در اموال مشمول خمس
states: A debt paid before dividing the estate; each heir pays pro rata to his share if paid after; heirs may not use the estate until paid unless intending to pay without delay.

heading: معاشرت با تارک خمس
topic: Using the property of those who do not pay khums
states: Allowed, even if certain it is liable; family members may use the household head's property.

heading: معامله با تارک خمس
topic: Dealing with those who do not pay
states: Trading and partnership are valid; a buyer may use goods whose khums the seller did not pay; each partner pays on his own share.

heading: اموال متعلّق خمس به فتوای مرجع قبلی
topic: Khums due under a previous Marja's fatwa
states: Gifts liable under the previous Marja's fatwa and unpaid need not be paid now; nor duties under Imam Khomeini's fatwa not acted on.
issues: Whom the person followed in each year is the person's answer.

heading: کسر مقدار خمسی که زیادتر پرداخت شده به عنوان بدهی خمس
states: Ask the office of religious funds.

heading: پس گرفتن وجوهات شرعیّه بعد از پرداخت آن
states: Not without the Marja's permission; mistaken payments: refer to the office.

heading: پرداخت خمس بدون قصد قربت
states: Discharges the duty.

heading: پرداخت خمس از طرف دیگری
states: Allowed; handing land to children on condition they pay its khums does not discharge the father if they do not.

heading: تحویل خمس از طریق بانک
states: Allowed.

heading: بخشش و مصالحه خمس
states: Khums cannot be forgiven; a definite khums cannot be forgiven or settled.
issues: Settlement in this source is used for uncertain amounts only (Q231, Q236, Q252, Q255).

heading: تلف شدن مبلغ خمس در دست واسطه
states: A careful intermediary is not liable; unless the intermediary is the Marja's agent, the duty remains.

heading: پرداخت خمس با سلب استطاعت حج
states: Khums is due at the year end; if paying it removes capacity and hajj was not previously settled, hajj is not obligatory.

heading: مؤونه معیشت و زندگی
states: Items that must be available (even if unused), consumables used up, and running costs (utilities, treatment, leisure, gifts, charity) are not liable.
